stem: Fill in the blank: The equilibrium constant K c is a measure of the ______ of a reaction at equilibrium.
Fill in the blank: The value of the equilibrium constant is ______ by the presence of a catalyst.
Fill in the blank: ______ is the equilibrium constant expressed in terms of the concentrations of the reactants and products.
Fill in the blank: If the value of K c is much larger than 1, the ______ are favoured at equilibrium.
Fill in the blank: The calculation of equilibrium involves solving for the ______ of the reactants and products at equilibrium.
True or false: K c and K p are always equal to each other.
True or false: The equilibrium constant is dimensionless.
True or false: Changes in temperature will affect the value of the equilibrium constant.
True or false: The equilibrium constant for the reverse reaction is the reciprocal of the equilibrium constant for the forward reaction.
True or false: The equilibrium constant includes the concentration of pure solids and liquids.

Match the column. Column-I: (A) K c (B) K p (C) Equilibrium constant (D) Calculation of equilibrium (E) Characteristics of equilibrium constant Column-II: (p) Describes the relative amounts of products and reactants at equilibrium (q) Solving for the concentrations of the reactants and products at equilibrium (r) Equilibrium constant in terms of concentration (s) Equilibrium constant in terms of partial pressure (t) Unaffected by the addition of a catalyst, only changes with temperature
